defects.description: Vulnerable OPTION_RE regular expression prone to ReDoS (call site in parse_options_header at lines 101-117)

cases.reproducer: Exact advisory PoC payload (`header = 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded; !="' + ('\\' * N)`) executed locally in controlled benchmark subprocess across commits `d3d16dae` vs `20f0ef6b`; demonstrated exponential backtracking (O(2^(N/2))), stalling at 2.1266s at N=37 on buggy unpatched revision vs 0.00002s on fixed (92,461.7x slowdown).
